title: GitHub signals
subtitle: Turn your published release notes into content ideas.

not_connected.what_we_read: SOSH reads published release notes from the repositories you choose.
not_connected.what_we_never_do: SOSH will never write to your repositories — no commits, no issues, no pull requests, ever.

awaiting_approval.title: Awaiting organization approval
awaiting_approval.body: Your GitHub organization requires owner approval before this installation can proceed. Ask an organization owner to approve the SOSH GitHub App request, then return to this page.

reconnect_required.title: Reconnect required
reconnect_required.body: GitHub reports this connection was revoked, so SOSH stopped receiving updates. Reconnect to resume ingestion.

rate_limited.banner: GitHub's rate limit was reached. Ingestion resumes automatically — there's nothing to do.

repo_unavailable.badge: This repository was deleted, renamed, or removed from the installation.

at_cap.title: Watch list full
at_cap.body: You're watching 20 repositories, the maximum. Remove one before adding another.

picker.heading: Add a repository
picker.empty: No additional repositories are available from this installation.

watch_list.heading: Watched repositories
watch_list.empty: You're not watching any repositories yet.

disconnect.confirm_body_stops_ingestion: Disconnecting stops SOSH from reading new release notes. It does not revoke GitHub's access.
disconnect.confirm_body_full_revocation: To fully revoke access, uninstall the SOSH app from your GitHub account or organization settings.

errors.invalid_request: That request wasn't valid. Please try connecting again.
errors.invalid_state: Your session expired during setup. Please try connecting again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to manage this connection.
errors.exchange_failed: We couldn't complete the connection to GitHub. Please try again.
errors.not_your_installation: That GitHub installation doesn't belong to you.
errors.already_connected: This GitHub installation is already connected to another workspace.
errors.repos_fetch_failed: We couldn't load your repositories. Please try again.
errors.watchlist_cap_reached: You're already watching 20 repositories, the maximum.
errors.watchlist_add_failed: We couldn't add that repository. Please try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

market_responsive.heading: Market-responsive feeds
market_responsive.subtitle: Add RSS or Atom feeds from industry publications. SOSH triages new articles alongside your own product releases.
market_responsive.disclosure_lower_confidence: Cards drawn from news feeds are triaged at a lower confidence than cards from your own product releases, until this source has a longer track record.
market_responsive.disclosure_standing_slot: If you watch only one feed, that feed is guaranteed a slot in every triage run. Watching a second feed removes that guarantee.

feed_list.heading: Watched feeds
feed_list.empty: You're not watching any feeds yet.

errors.feed_cap_reached: You're already watching 20 feeds, the maximum.
